clean_main_node_modules: clean the main node_modules directory from a given project path with optional package lock removal
clean_single_react_app: clean a single React app's build directory, node_modules, and optionally its package lock file
remove_package_locks_clean_main: remove the package-lock.json file along with node_modules when cleaning the main project directory
verbose_clean_react_app: clean a React app directory with verbose logging to show which paths are being removed
clean_react_app_no_locks: clean a React app's build and node_modules directories without removing the package lock file
